basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm an avid gamer from Chicago who recently stumbled upon the world of rhythm games, particularly osu! When I'm not trying to hit those perfect beats, I spend my time exploring visual novels like Katawa Shoujo or strategizing as a Jax main in League of Legends. I'm currently a college student studying Computer Science, which keeps me pretty busy, but I always make time for my gaming sessions in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies. I'm relatively new to Reddit and still figuring out the ropes, so please bear with me!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in the gaming world primarily comes from years of playing various genres and platforms. I've always been a PC enthusiast and learned most of what I know through self-exploration and online communities. I'm also studying Computer Science, which helps me understand the technical aspects of gaming and troubleshooting issues like the osu! map freezing problem.
